verbosity.description: Logging detail level (0=only errors, 1=operations, 2=detail, 3/4 debug) for dnssec-trigger.

pidfile.description: Path to the PID file used by dnssec-triggerd.

logfile.description: Path to the log file instead of syslog.

resolvconf.description: Path to the resolv.conf file to edit.

domain.description: Domain name to add to resolv.conf.

search.description: Domain name search path to add to resolv.conf.

login_command.description: Command to open login pages on hotspots.

login_location.description: URL to open for hotspot login.

noaction.description: Do not perform any actions (dry-run mode, 'yes' or 'no').

port.description: Port number for the probe daemon.

server_key_file.description: Path to the server private key file for TLS communication.

server_cert_file.description: Path to the server certificate file for TLS communication.

control_key_file.description: Path to the control private key file for TLS communication.

control_cert_file.description: Path to the control certificate file for TLS communication.

check_updates.description: Check for updates and ask to install them ('yes' or 'no').

use_vpn_forwarders.description: Use VPN servers for all traffic ('yes' or 'no').

use_private_addresses.description: Forward RFC 1918 private addresses to global forwarders ('yes' or 'no').

add_wifi_provided_zones.description: Add domains provided by VPN connections into Unbound forward zones ('yes' or 'no').
